(A)_[20 miles an hour on the apron or roads]_
(B)_[a speed limit, namely **(..SPECIFY LIMIT..), indicated by a sign erected in a conspicuous or appropriate position]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 5.1.5 of the Manchester Airport Byelaws 2024.
